name: OKLab
author: Björn Ottosson
description: Perceptually uniform color space designed for image processing and color manipulation. Outperforms CIELAB for hue uniformity. Based on a linear transform of the Bradford-adapted XYZ via a non-linear cube root.

cylindrical_form.name: OKLCh
cylindrical_form.notes: OKLCh is the cylindrical version. Use h for hue rotation, C for chroma control. Much better than HSL for perceptual hue harmony.

steps: Apply linear sRGB to LMS matrix

art_notes: Interpolating in OKLab gives you the 'true' path between colors as your eyes perceive it. Gradients don't go gray in the middle. Hue rotations stay equally bright. This is the space you actually want.
